items.title: BioLab
items.description: A space for biological experimentation and artistic investigations involving living systems, including the associated artistic research I Want to Make an Onion Cry.

items.title: Makerspace
items.description: A workstation for 3D printing, laser cutting and the fabrication of custom components for experimental research.

items.title: Dirty Workshop
items.description: A space for woodworking, drilling, cutting, mechanical construction and adapting machines and tools for research.

items.title: Electronics Bench
items.description: A workstation for electronic experimentation, circuit prototyping, soldering, PCB design and embedded systems.

items.title: Wearables Lab
items.description: A research workstation exploring wearable electronics, electronic textiles and interfaces between bodies and technology.

items.title: Craft Office
items.description: A space for paper engineering, cardboard mechanisms, crafts and printing, with sublimation printing planned.

items.title: Studio
items.description: A dedicated space for lighting, photography, documenting research processes and producing instructional media.

items.title: Saloon
items.description: The central working area for assembling prototypes and installations, hands-on experimentation and sharing works in progress during Open Research Studio.
